caption: The drawing depicts a single metal candlestick holder positioned upright in the center of the composition. The candlestick holder features a wide, rounded base that gradually narrows upward, forming a bulbous midsection before extending into a cylindrical neck and a slightly flared rim at the top. The object is rendered in shades of gray and black, suggesting metallic material and catching highlights and shadows to convey dimensionality. The background is plain and unembellished, with the candlestick holder centered within a faint rectangular border. The drawing is monochromatic, utilizing pencil or charcoal on an off-white or light beige paper. In the lower right corner, the name "JOSEPH WOLINS" is inscribed.
title: Candlestick
